hall.title: Eiffel Tower
hall.note: I really really enjoy playing with your Robotic arm, please please don't take it away. EVER !!!! I can't believe it took me 2 hours and 9 min. to complete this, but I couldn't make up my mind on what to build, so I finally decided to just keep it simple...

images.alt: A tall, narrow tower of dark and pale blocks on a four-legged base, seen beside the robot gripper
Close view of a slender block tower rising from the table grid

hall.title: Wobbly Tower
hall.note: My horrible leaning tower! This was it, I had to jet off to work. I took this pic just before I tried to pick up the one block in the foreground of the second pic. and set it on top all in one move, it all came crashing down, its amazing what 5 mm can do!

images.alt: A tall stack of blocks topped by a curved piece, standing on the table with loose blocks around it
A leaning tower of blocks at the far edge of the table grid beside the robot arm

hall.title: Four legs
hall.note: Here's a new entry for you "Hall of Fame"... Please consider it. The hardest part was the four corner posts. Keeping from knocking them over when placing the last one was an interesting affair! The top piece was no piece of cake either.

images.alt: A table-like structure of block posts with a flat top, seen close up

A bridge of red and blue blocks spanning a gap, with a red triangular block on top and the gripper above

A tall tower of blocks with a block-with-hole near the base, beside the robot gripper

hall.title: The Pyramid
hall.note: this project took me just under 3 hours to complete, and approximately 120 moves.

images.alt: Five small camera frames showing a brick pyramid being built on the table

hall.title: The Round House
hall.note: Another three dimensional structure. These are in the minority.

images.alt: A round house of red, yellow and blue blocks with an arched base and triangular roof

hall.title: Three-dimensional structure
hall.note: Matt spent four hours here on 29 September 1997 but not all of it building this.

images.alt: A three-dimensional block structure standing on the table with the gripper at right

hall.title: All the way from Los Angeles
hall.note: Not bad for 6 hours! The peg in the hole was a nice touch.

hall.title: A castle
hall.note: Here is a castle made on the 4th of February, 1997, by someone! If this is yours, we'd love to hear from you :)

images.alt: A castle of coloured blocks on the table, with the orange arm and gripper above

hall.title: The “highest” structure yet built
hall.note: Hats off to your patience John! Taking the structure from table height to maximum Z (450) in 5mm steps must have taken ages!
